temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan has noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but is putting his health at risk through overwork, and that Gary may need a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that he feels overwhelmed by hospital obligations and is reluctant or unable to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is overworking and remains at risk, and that Gary is not yet ready or able to accept a break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue encouraging Gary to rest and accept help, and find another way to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and needs rest, but has not yet realized there may be deeper personal or professional reasons behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, evasiveness, and admission that things are complicated make Ethan suspect that Gary is hiding a deeper burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is dealing with something more complicated than simple overwork and is withholding it to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and increasingly suspicious or apprehensive
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront Gary gently and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help without judging.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan offers to help Gary prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities, and Gary agrees.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is hiding a complicated burden and may be reluctant to share it because he does not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary reveals the specific pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges behind his overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan understands why Gary has been overworking: Gary is facing new-department pressures and personal challenges, and can improve with support and better organization.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary find a better balance by prioritizing tasks, delegating responsibilities, and organizing his schedule.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports improvement, says he is less overwhelmed, and mentions he had time for a movie last weekend, though challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary can improve with support and is starting to work toward a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts show that the support is working and that Gary is making real progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is making progress and becoming less overwhelmed, though Gary still faces some challenges.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in with Gary and offering encouragement and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and credits Ethan's support. Ethan sees that Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving but may still benefit from regular support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's successful adjustment, gratitude, and sense of control show that he can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a healthier balance and is capable of managing on his own, so Ethan no longer needs to intervene actively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back and let Gary manage independently, while remaining available if Gary ever needs help.
